title: Pyramid of the Sun
summary: The Pyramid of the Sun, also known as the Temple of Sun, is the largest temple in the Aztec capital of Teotihuacan, Mexico, and was dedicated to Quetzalcoatl, the Legendary Titan of Summons, whose Ring it contained. Using an ancient ritual, the temple could activate the Blue Star as part of an ancient signal to call the scattered Casterwill family members to reunite at the Fortress of Iron Will.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Pyramid was built by an unknown civilisation as the largest structure in the city. It was taken over by many cultures, each trying to erase the history of those before them. It was dedicated by the Aztecs to the Quetzalcoatl, a mythical feathered serpent. According to legend, when the sun's path directly aligned with the pyramid, the shadow of the serpent would be cast on the square of the ancient city. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] Another temple, the Pyramid of the Moon was built in the city nearby, and an ancient Pyramidallion was hidden between them. [TCG:LGS-B4]

Teien Casterwill sent the Huntik team on a mission to activate the Blue Star from the temple in order to call the out of hiding in order to fight the Blood Spiral. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Kiel and his team of Casterwill Hunters pursued the team to the Pyramid of the Sun. While Dante Vale and Sophie Casterwill fought against Kiel outside the temple, Lok Lambert, Den Fears, and Cherit fought against Marduk. Amid the frenzy, Lok was able to invoke the Legendary Titan of Summons, Quetzalcoatl, who was revealed to be the Blue Star. The star was spotted by many of the Casterwills, including Nimue Casterwill, Vivian Casterwill, Lucas Casterwill and Focauld Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*The Pyramid of the Sun is the first location to appear in the ''[[Huntik Trading Card Game]]'' prior to its appearance in the TV series. Additionally, the [[TCG:LGS-091|Pyramid]] card in which it first appears is designed to represent both itself and the [[Pyramid of the Moon]] on the Mission Map. Both Pyramids appear on [[TCG:LGS-B4|LGS-B4 - Unlock the Pyramid's Secret]]. 
*The Pyramid of the Sun is the third-largest pyramid in the world, standing at 65 metres high, and with a base of 225 metres per side.
